## Summary

Describe the user-facing problem and the resulting behavior.

## Scope

- [ ] The change is limited to the stated problem.
- [ ] Generated references, source coverage, or release contents are updated when needed.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, private manuscript text, or unrelated files are included.

## Validation

- [ ] Standard skill validator
- [ ] Project validator
- [ ] Unit tests
- [ ] `git diff --check`
- [ ] Release archive checks, when release contents changed

## Compatibility

Describe any change to installation paths, skill invocation, references, or supported hosts.
